name: OneDrive
description: Stop OneDrive from starting, syncing or showing up in File Explorer, or remove it.

tweaks.name: Stop OneDrive starting with Windows
tweaks.summary: OneDrive no longer opens when you sign in.
tweaks.description: Removes the OneDrive entry from your startup programs. OneDrive still works if you open it yourself.
tweaks.undo: The startup entry is saved first. Undo puts it back.

tweaks.name: Remove OneDrive from the File Explorer sidebar
tweaks.summary: Hides the OneDrive item in the left pane of File Explorer.
tweaks.description: Hides OneDrive in the File Explorer navigation pane for your account. Your OneDrive folder and files stay where they are.

tweaks.name: Stop "back up your folders" prompts
tweaks.summary: OneDrive no longer offers to move Desktop, Documents and Pictures to the cloud.
tweaks.description: Blocks OneDrive folder backup (Known Folder Move) by policy, so OneDrive stops asking to move your Desktop, Documents and Pictures folders. Folders already moved stay as they are.

tweaks.name: Disable OneDrive sync
tweaks.summary: Blocks OneDrive from syncing files on this PC.
tweaks.description: Sets the policy that stops OneDrive from syncing for all users. Files already on the PC stay, but files that are online-only stay in the cloud and cannot be opened from this PC until you undo it.
tweaks.goodToKnow: Before you turn sync off, right-click your OneDrive folder and choose Always keep on this device if you want local copies of everything.

tweaks.name: Uninstall OneDrive
tweaks.summary: Removes the OneDrive app using Microsoft's own uninstaller.
tweaks.description: Closes OneDrive and runs the uninstaller that OneDrive registered with Windows. Files in your OneDrive folder on this PC are not deleted, and nothing is deleted from the cloud.
tweaks.undo: Undo runs the OneDrive installer that ships with Windows, if it is still there. If not, download OneDrive from microsoft.com.
